name: Praying For A Mate
overview: Scripture reveals God's design for companionship and marriage as essential to human flourishing, beginning with His declaration that it is not good for man to be alone and His provision of a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). Marriage is portrayed as a sacred union where a man and woman leave their parents to become one flesh (Genesis 2:24), reflecting God's intention for intimate, lifelong partnership. The Bible also encourages believers to seek God's blessing in finding rest and joy within the household of a spouse (Ruth 1:9; Psalms 113:9), trusting that delighting in the Lord leads to the fulfillment of the desires of the heart (Psalms 37:4). Furthermore, God is shown as the One who places the solitary into families, emphasizing His sovereign care in providing relational and familial bonds (Psalms 68:6).
